summary: Codex's schema design report is well-grounded — 9/9 spot-checked citations into commit.sh / push.sh / close-verdict.py / agents/dev.md / agents/ba.md / commands/{dev,close,commit}.md verify exactly. The verdict regex correctly admits all 7 close.md legal forms and rejects the known-broken 'Final verdict: CLOSE: YES' form. The 6 drift-map rows are all real (no fakes flagged). However, the report has 5 substantive gaps that block adoption to ~/.claude/contracts/: (1) M1 schema does not require ticket-vs-context AC alignment, masking the iter-3 ticket vs iter-2 context drift visible in this cycle; (2) M2 dev-report schema omits ~10 well-known dev.* fields that real reports populate (qa_notes, byte_identity_verified, blast_radius_verified, local_typecheck_status, etc.); (3) M4 schema models the LEGACY v3 manifest while the live commit path produces semantic-plan meta — mislabeled as authoritative; (4) NO schema exists for qa-report-*.json (real artifacts use TOP-LEVEL status, agents/qa.md mandates qa.status nested — a full membrane gap); (5) NO schema exists for ba-qa-report-*.json (BA-validation membrane). Codex's own self-audit corroborates 4 of 5 gaps. Verdict: needs_revision — fix the 5 gaps, then re-audit before saving to contracts/.
